e.title: 再保条约智能体：正则优先、LLM 兜底，并对每个抽取值回查其引证页原文
e.title_en: A reinsurance treaty agent that tries regex first, falls back to an LLM, then checks every extracted field against the page it cites
e.title_hk: 再保條約智能體：正則優先、LLM 兜底，並對每個抽取值回查其引證頁原文
e.summary: 一个把再保条约 PDF 抽成结构化条款的 LangGraph 智能体：先用正则按 Label: value 约定抽取，缺字段时才交给 LLM 兜底；随后用一个确定性的 grounding 检查把每个抽取值回查它自己引证的页面原文，对不上的字段只标记警告、不静默采信也不阻断流程
e.summary_hk: 一個把再保條約 PDF 抽成結構化條款的 LangGraph 智能體：先用正則按 Label: value 約定抽取，缺欄位時才交給 LLM 兜底；隨後用一個確定性的 grounding 檢查把每個抽取値回查它自己引證的頁面原文，對不上的欄位只標記警告、不靜默採信也不阻斷流程
e.summary_en: A LangGraph agent that extracts reinsurance treaty PDFs into structured terms: regex reads them first under a Label: value convention, and only missing fields go to an LLM fallback; a subsequent deterministic grounding check then verifies each extracted value against the actual text of the page it cites, flagging unsupported fields as warnings rather than silently trusting them or blocking the workflow
e.body:
**reinsurance-treaty-agent** 是一个**把再保条约 PDF 抽成结构化条款的智能体**（仓库 `iva2020dev/reinsurance-treaty-agent`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 1,222 KB、创建于 2026-09-03、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`NONE`）**、**无 topics**；**README 实测 49,028 字节**；**另有实测实时演示地址 `reinsurance-treaty-agent-extraction.streamlit.app`**。本条目属于本轮主题**「交接处——一个东西换手时会发生什么」**中的**第一种：对方写的那份文件，怎么变成我方的数字**。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库根目录实测**）：**根目录实测含 `.claude`、`.devcontainer`、`.githooks`、`.github`、`.idea`、`.streamlit`、`AGENTS.md`（12,583 字节）、`CLAUDE.md`（9,967 字节）、`TASKS.md`（13,090 字节）、`CANDIDATE_TASKS.md`（35,709 字节）、**`REASONING.md`（255,348 字节）**、`README.md`（49,028 字节）、`pytest.ini`（73 字节）、`requirements.txt`（118 字节）以及 `data/`、`scripts/`、`src/`、`tests/`**。**其技术栈与 AI 工具链逐字自述**：**「Tech Stack: Python 3.11+, Pydantic v2, LangGraph (for deterministic agent orchestration), FastAPI (for API/services), Pytest (testing), Docker & Streamlit (for easy deployment & UI). **AI Tooling: Claude Code (CLI) inside PyCharm, interacting with Claude 3.5 Sonnet via Anthropic API.**」**——**⭐ 把自己的构建工具链（Claude Code、Claude 3.5 Sonnet）写进仓库描述，这在本站收录的项目中少见**。⭐⭐⭐ **其工作流逐字实测，是本条目最有价值的部分**：**`src/workflow.py` 是一个 LangGraph 状态机**——**① Extractor Node 用正则从解析后的文本里读条约条款**；**② 若一个或多个必需字段找不到**（**例如条约写成散文而非 `Label: value` 约定**），**由 LLM Extraction Fallback Node 用 `Claude Haiku 4.5` 的 structured tool-use 输出尝试抽取**；**③ 随后 `check_treaty_grounding()`（`src/tools.py`）把每个抽取值**回查它所引证页面的实际文本**，对源文本并不支持的字段**标记（flagging）而非阻断（not blocking）****；**④ Verifier Node 检查完整性，并在完整时**查该 cedent（分出公司）的历史索赔****；**⑤ Burn-Cost Check Node 计算赔付率并标记异常**；**⑥ 若 LLM 兜底后仍不完整（含其重试），图将在 Verifier Node 之后结束，而不进入 Burn-Cost Check Node**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「正则优先、LLM 兜底」这一顺序设计是本条目最值得学的一点**——**它把**确定性方法**放在前面，**只在确定性方法确实找不到时才付 LLM 的代价与不确定性****；**而更关键的是它把两者的**失败边界写清楚了**：**正则失败的条件是**条约写成了散文而非 `Label: value` 约定****——**即失败原因是**可描述、可构造测试用例**的**（**其 `data/` 里特意放了 `sample_rich_fuzzy_treaty.pdf`，**事实与 rich 版相同但写成散文，用以逼出 LLM 兜底路径****）（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该顺序在所有场景都优于纯 LLM**——**本次未测其两种路径的准确率对比**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ `check_treaty_grounding()` 是「flagging, not blocking」这一取舍的又一实例，且是本站同一条纪律的第 7 次出现**——**它**不是再调一次 LLM 判断**，**而是**确定性地**把抽取值与**它自己引证的那一页的实际文本**比对**（**README 逐字说明这是「a deterministic grounding check, not another LLM call」**）；**对不上的字段**只标警告并指名是哪个字段，而不静默采信****。⭐⭐ **完整线索**：**[[powmcp-skills]]（319）→ [[rag-assurance]]（321）→ [[underwriting-decision-safety]]（323）→ [[claims-triage-risk-scoring-agent]]（325）→ [[sharia-compliance-agent]] 的 `NEEDS_REVIEW`（327）→ [[motor-loss-reserving-dl]] 的缺陷清单（328）→ **本条（329）****；**本条的特殊之处在于**它把「不采信」做成了**逐字段的、指名道姓的警告****，**而不是整份文件退回**——**即它保留了**可用部分的可用性****。**③ ⭐⭐ **「瞬态失败重试两次、非瞬态失败立即失败」这一区分值得单独记一笔**：**README 逐字为「up to 2 retries with exponential backoff (1s, then 2s) — before giving up; a non-transient failure (e.g. an invalid API key) fails immediately, unretried」**——**把**超时／网络抖动／限流／服务瞬时过载**（可重试）与**API key 无效**（重试无意义）分开**，**是本会话少见的、把**重试语义**写清楚的项目**（**⚠️ 本次未读其 `src/llm_client.py` 实现**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **抽取准确率评测套件与单元测试是分开的两件事**——**`tests/eval/` 是一个**独立于 `pytest tests/` 的小型评测台**，**对一份标注过的 golden dataset 给**整条抽取流水线（含 LLM 兜底）打准确率分**，**而不只是判断测试是否通过**：**对 4 个标量字段（`cedent_name`、`attachment_point`、`limit`、`reinsurance_premium`）算**逐字段准确率**，**对列表字段 `exclusions` 算**集合式 precision/recall**（**因 LLM 的条款措辞即使正确也可能不同，故用**归一化子串包含**匹配**）。⭐⭐⭐ **其存在理由逐字写明**：**「This is what would catch a prompt or model-version regression that still "passes" (extracts *something*) but gets the actual values wrong.」**——**即专门捕捉那种**换了模型或改了提示词后测试仍通过、但值已经错了**的回归****。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **它连自己的评分器也测**：**`tests/eval/test_eval_suite.py` 用**被 mock 的 LLM 客户端**（而非真实 API）确定性地测试评分器本身**，**其中包括一份**故意做坏的 mock 抽取结果（值错误、`exclusions` 列表被丢掉）**，**并断言评分准确率**确实下降****——**即验证「这套评测真的能发现错误」**，**而不是只验证它能跑**（**本会话同源线索：第 328 轮 [[motor-loss-reserving-dl]] 的「验证中发现并修复的程序缺陷」一节**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **5 个 golden case 覆盖两条路径**：2 个正则路径（`sample_treaty.pdf`、`sample_rich_treaty.pdf`）与 **3 个 LLM 路径、且刻意写成三种不同散文风格**（`sample_rich_fuzzy_treaty.pdf`、`golden_harborlight_treaty.pdf`（用 `USD 500,000` 式数字格式）、`golden_continental_treaty.pdf`（用 `USD 750,000.00` 式格式、不同免责集合））——**即它不假设 LLM 只面对**一种散文风格****（**⚠️ 本次未运行该套件，未核实上表所列 100% 的分数为本次实测**——**该分数是 README 中给出的样例输出**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **3 个 LLM 路径用例在缺 `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` 时报**skipped 而非 failing****，**2 个正则路径永远可跑**——**这是一个让**无密钥的贡献者与 CI** 仍能获得部分信号的实用安排**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张** skipped 不会被误读为通过**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **工作流图由 pre-commit 钩子自动重生成**——**README 逐字说明该 mermaid 图在 `src/workflow.py` 进入提交时由 `.githooks/pre-commit` 自动重写**，**启用方式是 `git config core.hooksPath .githooks`**；**这解决的是**文档与实际流程脱节**这一常见问题**（**可与 [[reproducible-actuarial-work]]、[[verified-reserving]] 并读**）。**⑨ ⭐⭐ **只接线「已实现的任务」**：**`build_workflow_graph()` 接受一组可选的 domain-task ID（默认仅 Burn-Cost Check）**，**而按 `src/domain_tasks.py` 的注册表，**只有该集合中**已实现**的任务才会被接到 Verifier Node 之后****——**即架构为未来任务预留了位置，但**不假装它们已存在****（**它当前是唯一已实现的任务**）（**可与第 328 轮 [[creance]] 的「调度器只打印计划」、第 327 轮 [[cloud-itonami-isic-6520]] 的两处 `(honest)` 并读**）。**⑩ ⭐⭐ **`REASONING.md`（255,348 字节，73 条，2026-09-03 至 2026-09-10）自述为「the reasoning transcript of the AI agent for the current session」**，**每条为 `## 日期 时间 — Task: 标题（任务 ID）` 并含 **Goal／Analysis／Decision／Action** 四段**；**其 2026-09-03 首条（`spec-first-file-structure`）的 Decision 段解释了**为何不提前发明 schema**（「inventing schemas/logic ahead of a real spec would be scope creep」），**并指出**空测试文件虽然可被发现、却不能证明收集真的工作****；**其近期任务标题含 **「Per-task cost estimation (pre-run) & actual cost tracking (post-run)」**（**按任务的成本预估与实际成本追踪**）与 **「Dynamic graph fan-out for multi-task selection」**（**⚠️ 本次只读其首条与任务标题清单，未读多数组内文**）。**⑪ ⭐ **调试面板逐字实测**：显示本次走的是哪条抽取路径（Regex only／LLM Extraction Fallback／两次都失败及原因）、**逐节点带时间戳的执行日志（含每次重试与下次尝试前的退避延迟）**、**原始工作流状态 JSON（含 `extraction_method`、`llm_error`）**，**并可把本次日志按 Append／Overwrite 写入 `logs/workflow.log`**——**即可追溯性做进了界面**。**⑫ ⭐ 可与本站再保与文档抽取条目并读**：[[reinsurance-contracts-repository]]（**再保合同语料，其 NLP 的数据基础**）、[[rs-ins-reinsurance-layer-pricing]]、[[clausegraph]]、[[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]]、[[reinsurance-treaty-intelligence]]（**本批同轮的另一种读法**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 该仓库实测**无任何许可文件（`NONE`）****——**本词条明确记录，并提示使用、部署或再分发其代码前必须自行确认授权状况**；**②** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、仓库根目录清单、README（49,028 字节）的工作流说明、重试语义、评测套件、覆盖率说明、调试面板与部署说明，以及 `REASONING.md`（255,348 字节）的首条与任务标题清单**，⭐⭐ **但**未安装、未运行、未克隆、未调用其在线演示、未读 `src/` 下任何源码、未运行其 pytest 或评测套件、未读 `REASONING.md` 多数组内文、未读 `TASKS.md`／`CANDIDATE_TASKS.md`／`AGENTS.md`／`CLAUDE.md` 正文****，因此**不能转述其正则表达式、提示词、`check_treaty_grounding()` 的具体比对算法、`src/domain_tasks.py` 的注册表内容、Burn-Cost Check 的异常判定规则或任何数值**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ README 中那份**6 项全部 100%**的评测输出是**仓库自带的样例**，**本次**未运行该套件、未核实其真实性或可复现性****；**本词条**不主张**其抽取准确率达到任何水平**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**其「grounding check」能否真正发现 LLM 的取值错误**——**其有效性取决于「引证页码」本身是否由同一 LLM 给出**（**若页号也错，回查就会查错页**）；**README 未说明页号来源，**本词条据此**不主张**该检查足以替代人工复核**；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其 Burn-Cost Check 所用「历史索赔」来自何处**（**README 未说明数据来源，可能为内置示例**）；**⑥ ⭐ **未核实**其唯一已实现领域任务的**方法**是否恰当**（**赔付率本身不是准备金结论**）；**⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ **该工具处理的是**受法律约束的再保条约文本****，**其抽取结果若用于真实定价、核保或争议**必须经人工复核**；**README 亦未主张可作法律依据**；**本词条**不主张**其输出可用于任何真实交易或法律用途**；**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核实**其在线演示（Streamlit Community Cloud）当前是否可访问及其行为**——**本次未访问**；**⑨ ⭐ ★0、fork 0**，**关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度、方法可靠性或已被采用**；**⑩ ⭐ README 长 49,028 字节但仓库**无描述之外的说明、无 topics**；**⑪ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**（**README 实测为英文**）。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/iva2020dev/reinsurance-treaty-agent`、`/readme` 与 `/contents/` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 49,028 字节，工作流、重试、评测、覆盖率与调试面板各段逐字核对；`REASONING.md` 经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测 255,348 字节，条目数与日期跨度以行首 `^## 20` 计数）；**未安装、未运行、未调用其演示、未读源码与多数文档正文**。

**reinsurance-treaty-agent** 是一個**把再保條約 PDF 抽成結構化條款的智能體**（倉庫 `iva2020dev/reinsurance-treaty-agent`），**實測 ★0、fork 0、主語言 Python、體量 1,222 KB、創建於 2026-09-03、最後推送 2026-09-10**（**在解凍窗口內**）；**⚠️ 該倉庫實測無任何許可文件（`NONE`）**、**無 topics**；**README 實測 49,028 位元組**；**另有實測即時演示位址 `reinsurance-treaty-agent-extraction.streamlit.app`**。本條目屬本輪主題**「交接處——一個東西換手時會發生什麼」**中的**第一種：對方寫的那份文件，怎麼變成我方的數字**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫根目錄實測**）：**根目錄實測含 `.claude`、`.devcontainer`、`.githooks`、`.github`、`.idea`、`.streamlit`、`AGENTS.md`（12,583 位元組）、`CLAUDE.md`（9,967 位元組）、`TASKS.md`（13,090 位元組）、`CANDIDATE_TASKS.md`（35,709 位元組）、**`REASONING.md`（255,348 位元組）**、`README.md`、`pytest.ini`、`requirements.txt` 以及 `data/`、`scripts/`、`src/`、`tests/`**。**技術棧與 AI 工具鏈逐字自述**：**「Tech Stack: Python 3.11+, Pydantic v2, LangGraph (for deterministic agent orchestration), FastAPI (for API/services), Pytest (testing), Docker & Streamlit (for easy deployment & UI). **AI Tooling: Claude Code (CLI) inside PyCharm, interacting with Claude 3.5 Sonnet via Anthropic API.**」**。⭐⭐⭐ **工作流逐字實測，是本條目最有價值之處**：**`src/workflow.py` 是一個 LangGraph 狀態機**——**① Extractor Node 用正則從解析後的文字裡讀條約條款**；**② 若一個或多個必需欄位找不到**（**例如條約寫成散文而非 `Label: value` 約定**），**由 LLM Extraction Fallback Node 用 `Claude Haiku 4.5` 的 structured tool-use 輸出嘗試抽取**；**③ 隨後 `check_treaty_grounding()` 把每個抽取値**回查它所引證頁面的實際文字**，對來源文字並不支持的欄位**標記（flagging）而非阻斷（not blocking）****；**④ Verifier Node 檢查完整性，並在完整時**查該 cedent 的歷史索賠****；**⑤ Burn-Cost Check Node 計算賠付率並標記異常**；**⑥ 若 LLM 兜底後仍不完整，圖將在 Verifier Node 之後結束而不進入 Burn-Cost Check Node**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「正則優先、LLM 兜底」這一順序是最值得學的一點**——**把**確定性方法**放在前面，**只在確實找不到時才付 LLM 的代價與不確定性****；**且其**失敗邊界寫得清楚**：**正則失敗的條件是條約寫成散文而非 `Label: value` 約定****（**其 `data/` 特意放了 `sample_rich_fuzzy_treaty.pdf`，事實與 rich 版相同但寫成散文，用以逼出 LLM 兜底路徑**）（**⚠️ 不主張**該順序在所有場景都優於純 LLM**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ `check_treaty_grounding()` 是「flagging, not blocking」的又一實例，且是本站同一條紀律的第 7 次出現**——**它**不是再調一次 LLM 判斷****，**而是**確定性地**把抽取値與**它自己引證的那一頁的實際文字**比對**（**README 逐字說明為「a deterministic grounding check, not another LLM call」**）；**對不上的欄位**只標警告並指名是哪個欄位，而不靜默採信****。⭐⭐ **完整線索**：**[[powmcp-skills]]（319）→ [[rag-assurance]]（321）→ [[underwriting-decision-safety]]（323）→ [[claims-triage-risk-scoring-agent]]（325）→ [[sharia-compliance-agent]] 的 `NEEDS_REVIEW`（327）→ [[motor-loss-reserving-dl]] 的缺陷清單（328）→ **本條（329）****；**本條特殊之處在於**把「不採信」做成**逐欄位、指名道姓的警告****，**而非整份文件退回**——**保留了**可用部分的可用性****。**③ ⭐⭐ **「瞬態失敗重試兩次、非瞬態失敗立即失敗」值得單獨記**：**逐字「up to 2 retries with exponential backoff (1s, then 2s) — before giving up; a non-transient failure (e.g. an invalid API key) fails immediately, unretried」**——**把**逾時／網路抖動／限流／服務瞬時過載**與**API key 無效**分開**（**⚠️ 未讀其實現**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **抽取準確率評測套件與單元測試分開**——**`tests/eval/` 是**獨立於 `pytest tests/` 的小型評測台**，**對標注過的 golden dataset 給**整條流水線（含 LLM 兜底）打準確率分****：**對 4 個純量欄位（`cedent_name`、`attachment_point`、`limit`、`reinsurance_premium`）算**逐欄位準確率**，**對列表欄位 `exclusions` 算**集合式 precision/recall**（**用**歸一化子串包含**匹配，因 LLM 條款措辭即使正確也可能不同**）。⭐⭐⭐ **其存在理由逐字**：**「This is what would catch a prompt or model-version regression that still "passes" (extracts *something*) but gets the actual values wrong.」**——**即專門捕捉**換了模型或改了提示詞後測試仍通過、但値已經錯了**的迴歸****。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **它連自己的評分器也測**：**用**被 mock 的 LLM 客戶端**確定性地測試評分器本身**，**含一份**故意做壞的 mock 抽取結果**，**並斷言評分準確率**確實下降****。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **5 個 golden case 覆蓋兩條路徑**：2 個正則路徑與 **3 個 LLM 路徑、刻意寫成三種不同散文風格**（**⚠️ 本次未運行該套件，README 中 100% 的分數為**倉庫自帶樣例****）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **3 個 LLM 用例在缺 `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` 時報 skipped 而非 failing**（**⚠️ 不主張** skipped 不會被誤讀為通過**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **工作流圖由 pre-commit 鉤子自動重生成**（**`git config core.hooksPath .githooks` 啟用**）——**解決**文件與實際流程脫節****。**⑨ ⭐⭐ **只接線「已實作」的任務**：**`build_workflow_graph()` 按 `src/domain_tasks.py` 的註冊表，**只有該集合中已實作的任務才會接到 Verifier Node 之後****（**可與第 328 輪 [[creance]]、第 327 輪 [[cloud-itonami-isic-6520]] 並讀**）。**⑩ ⭐⭐ **`REASONING.md`（255,348 位元組，73 條，2026-09-03 至 09-10）自述為「the reasoning transcript of the AI agent for the current session」**，**每條含 **Goal／Analysis／Decision／Action** 四段**；**近期任務標題含「Per-task cost estimation (pre-run) & actual cost tracking (post-run)」與「Dynamic graph fan-out for multi-task selection」**（**⚠️ 只讀首條與標題清單**）。**⑪ ⭐ 調試面板逐字**：抽取路徑、逐節點帶時間戳日誌（含每次重試與退避延遲）、原始狀態 JSON（含 `extraction_method`、`llm_error`）、可寫入 `logs/workflow.log`。**⑫ ⭐ 可與 [[reinsurance-contracts-repository]]、[[rs-ins-reinsurance-layer-pricing]]、[[clausegraph]]、[[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]]、[[reinsurance-treaty-intelligence]] 並讀**。

**reinsurance-treaty-agent** is **an agent that extracts reinsurance treaty PDFs into structured terms** (repository `iva2020dev/reinsurance-treaty-agent`), with **measured ★0, 0 forks, Python as the primary language, a 1,222 KB repository, created 2026-09-03 and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**all GitHub API measurements, inside the thaw window**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file (`NONE`) and no topics**; **the README measures 49,028 bytes**; **and a live demo address, `reinsurance-treaty-agent-extraction.streamlit.app`, is measurably present**. It is the first of this round’s four takes on **the handoff point: what happens when something changes hands** — here, **how a document written by the counterparty becomes our own numbers**.

Verifiable details (**all measured from the README and the repository root**): **the root measurably contains `.claude`, `.devcontainer`, `.githooks`, `.github`, `.idea`, `.streamlit`, `AGENTS.md` (12,583 bytes), `CLAUDE.md` (9,967 bytes), `TASKS.md` (13,090 bytes), `CANDIDATE_TASKS.md` (35,709 bytes), **`REASONING.md` (255,348 bytes)**, `README.md`, `pytest.ini`, `requirements.txt`, and `data/`, `scripts/`, `src/`, `tests/`**. **Its stack and AI tooling read verbatim**: **"Tech Stack: Python 3.11+, Pydantic v2, LangGraph (for deterministic agent orchestration), FastAPI (for API/services), Pytest (testing), Docker & Streamlit (for easy deployment & UI). AI Tooling: Claude Code (CLI) inside PyCharm, interacting with Claude 3.5 Sonnet via Anthropic API."** — **naming its own build toolchain in the repository description is rare among the projects collected here**. ⭐⭐⭐ **Its workflow, read verbatim, is the entry’s most valuable part**: **`src/workflow.py` is a LangGraph state machine** — **① the Extractor Node reads treaty terms from parsed text via regex**; **② if one or more required fields cannot be found** (**for instance a treaty phrased as prose instead of a `Label: value` convention**), **the LLM Extraction Fallback Node attempts extraction using `Claude Haiku 4.5` with structured tool-use output**; **③ `check_treaty_grounding()` in `src/tools.py` then verifies each extracted field against the actual text of the page it cites, flagging rather than blocking any field the source text does not actually support**; **④ the Verifier Node checks completeness and, if complete, looks up historical claims for the cedent**; **⑤ the Burn-Cost Check Node computes the loss ratio and flags anomalies**; **⑥ if extraction is still incomplete after the LLM fallback, the graph ends after the Verifier Node instead of running the Burn-Cost Check Node**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ Regex first and LLM as fallback is the entry’s most instructive design point** — **it puts the deterministic method in front and pays the LLM’s cost and uncertainty only when the deterministic method genuinely fails**; **and more importantly it states the failure boundary**: **regex fails when a treaty is phrased as prose rather than a `Label: value` convention** — **a failure cause that is describable and can have test cases built for it** (**its `data/` deliberately ships `sample_rich_fuzzy_treaty.pdf`, carrying the same facts as the rich fixture but phrased as prose, to force the fallback path**) (**⚠️ the entry does not claim this ordering beats a pure-LLM approach in all settings — the two paths were not benchmarked against each other**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ `check_treaty_grounding()` is another instance of flagging, not blocking, and the seventh occurrence of this session’s recurring discipline** — **it does not ask an LLM to judge again**; **it deterministically compares an extracted value against the actual text of the very page that value cites** (**the README says verbatim that this is "a deterministic grounding check, not another LLM call"**); **a field that does not check out is flagged with a warning naming that field rather than silently trusted**. ⭐⭐ **The full line**: **[[powmcp-skills]] (319) → [[rag-assurance]] (321) → [[underwriting-decision-safety]] (323) → [[claims-triage-risk-scoring-agent]] (325) → `NEEDS_REVIEW` in [[sharia-compliance-agent]] (327) → the defect list in [[motor-loss-reserving-dl]] (328) → this entry (329)**; **what is distinctive here is that the distrust is made per-field and named**, **rather than returning the whole document** — **so the usable parts stay usable**. **③ ⭐⭐ The distinction between transient and non-transient failure deserves separate note**: the README reads verbatim "up to 2 retries with exponential backoff (1s, then 2s) — before giving up; a non-transient failure (e.g. an invalid API key) fails immediately, unretried" — **separating timeouts, network hiccups, rate limits and momentary server overload (worth retrying) from an invalid API key (pointless to retry)**, **a rare case of a project writing its retry semantics down clearly** (**its `src/llm_client.py` was not read**). **④ ⭐⭐ Extraction-accuracy evaluation and unit testing are two separate things** — **`tests/eval/` is a small harness separate from `pytest tests/` that scores the accuracy of the whole extraction pipeline (regex plus LLM fallback) against a labelled golden dataset**: **per-field accuracy for the four scalar fields (`cedent_name`, `attachment_point`, `limit`, `reinsurance_premium`)** and **set-based precision/recall for the list-valued `exclusions`** (**matched by normalised substring containment, since an LLM’s clause phrasing can vary even when correct**). ⭐⭐⭐ **Its stated reason reads verbatim**: **"This is what would catch a prompt or model-version regression that still "passes" (extracts something) but gets the actual values wrong."** **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ It even tests its own scorer**: **`tests/eval/test_eval_suite.py` tests the scorer deterministically with a mocked LLM client rather than the live API**, **including a deliberately-broken mocked extraction (wrong values, a dropped exclusions list)**, **and asserts the scored accuracy actually drops** — **verifying that the evaluation can detect errors, not merely that it runs** (**the same instinct as round 328’s [[motor-loss-reserving-dl]] and its list of defects found during verification**). **⑥ ⭐⭐ Five golden cases cover both paths**: two regex-path fixtures and **three LLM-path fixtures written as prose in three deliberately distinct styles** (`USD 500,000`-style formatting in one, `USD 750,000.00`-style in another) — **it does not assume the LLM faces only one prose style** (**⚠️ the suite was not run, and the all-100% table in the README is the repository’s own sample output**). **⑦ ⭐⭐ The three LLM cases are reported as skipped rather than failing when `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is absent**, **while the two regex cases always run** — **a practical arrangement giving keyless contributors and CI partial signal** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim skipped cannot be misread as passing**). **⑧ ⭐⭐ The workflow diagram is regenerated automatically by a pre-commit hook** — **the README states verbatim that the mermaid diagram is rewritten whenever `src/workflow.py` enters a commit, enabled by `git config core.hooksPath .githooks`** — **which addresses the common problem of documentation drifting from the actual flow** (**readable with [[reproducible-actuarial-work]] and [[verified-reserving]]**). **⑨ ⭐⭐ Only implemented tasks are wired in**: **`build_workflow_graph()` accepts an optional set of domain-task IDs (defaulting to just Burn-Cost Check)**, **and per the registry in `src/domain_tasks.py` only implemented tasks in that set get wired in after the Verifier Node** — **the architecture reserves a place for future tasks without pretending they exist** (**it is currently the only implemented task**; **readable with round 328’s [[creance]] and its scheduler that only prints its plan, and round 327’s [[cloud-itonami-isic-6520]]**). **⑩ ⭐⭐ `REASONING.md` (255,348 bytes, 73 entries from 2026-09-03 to 2026-09-10) describes itself as "the reasoning transcript of the AI agent for the current session"**, **each entry headed `## date time — Task: title (task-id)` and structured as Goal / Analysis / Decision / Action**; **the first entry of 2026-09-03 (`spec-first-file-structure`) explains in its Decision section why schemas should not be invented ahead of a real spec ("inventing schemas/logic ahead of a real spec would be scope creep"), and notes that an empty test file is discoverable but does not prove collection actually works**; **recent task titles include "Per-task cost estimation (pre-run) & actual cost tracking (post-run)" and "Dynamic graph fan-out for multi-task selection"** (**⚠️ only the first entry and the title list were read, not most entry bodies**). **⑪ ⭐ The debug panel reads verbatim**: which extraction path the run took (Regex only / LLM Extraction Fallback / both failed and why), **a per-node timestamped execution log including each retry and the backoff delay before the next attempt**, **the raw workflow state as JSON including `extraction_method` and `llm_error`**, **and a control writing the run to `logs/workflow.log` by Append or Overwrite** — **traceability built into the interface**. **⑫ ⭐ Readable with the corpus’s reinsurance and document-extraction entries**: [[reinsurance-contracts-repository]] (**a reinsurance contract corpus, the data basis for its NLP**), [[rs-ins-reinsurance-layer-pricing]], [[clausegraph]], [[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]], [[reinsurance-treaty-intelligence]] (**another reading of the same material this round**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ The repository measurably has no licence file (`NONE`)** — **recorded explicitly, with the advice to confirm authorisation before use, deployment or redistribution**; **②** this check verified **the repository metadata, the root listing, and the README’s 49,028 bytes in respect of its workflow, retry semantics, evaluation suite, coverage notes, debug panel and deployment, plus `REASONING.md`’s first entry and task-title list**, ⭐⭐ **but did not install, run, clone, call its online demo, read any source under `src/`, run its pytest or evaluation suite, read most `REASONING.md` entry bodies, or read the bodies of `TASKS.md`, `CANDIDATE_TASKS.md`, `AGENTS.md` or `CLAUDE.md`**, so **its regular expressions, prompts, the comparison algorithm inside `check_treaty_grounding()`, the registry contents of `src/domain_tasks.py`, the Burn-Cost Check anomaly rules and any numeric value cannot be restated**; **③ ⭐⭐⭐ The all-100% evaluation table in the README is the repository’s own sample output and the suite was not run**, **so its truth or reproducibility was not verified**; **the entry claims no level of extraction accuracy**; **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Whether its grounding check can actually catch an LLM value error was not verified** — **its effectiveness depends on whether the cited page number is itself produced by the same LLM** (**if the page number is wrong, the check reads the wrong page**); **the README does not say where page numbers come from, so the entry does not claim the check can replace human review**; **⑤ ⭐⭐ The provenance of the historical claims used by its Burn-Cost Check was not verified** (**the README does not state the data source; it may be built-in sample data**); **⑥ ⭐ Whether the method of its one implemented domain task is appropriate was not verified** (**a loss ratio is not itself a reserving conclusion**); **⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ The tool processes legally binding reinsurance treaty text**, **so its output would require human review before any real pricing, underwriting or dispute use**; **the README does not claim it is a legal basis**; **the entry does not claim its output is usable for any real transaction or legal purpose**; **⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ Whether its online demo (Streamlit Community Cloud) is currently reachable or how it behaves was not verified** (**it was not visited**); **⑨ ⭐ At ★0 and 0 forks attention is very low**, **so no maturity, method reliability or adoption is claimed**; **⑩ ⭐ A 49,028-byte README with no topics**; **⑪ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified** (**the README measurably is in English**). **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/iva2020dev/reinsurance-treaty-agent`, `/readme` and `/contents/` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (the 49,028-byte README with its workflow, retry, evaluation, coverage and debug-panel passages checked verbatim; `REASONING.md` measured at 255,348 bytes via `raw.githubusercontent.com`, with entry count and date span taken from `^## 20` line prefixes); **nothing installed, run, cloned or demo-called, and neither the source nor most document bodies read**.
